clue.text: Relative with a universal set of books

parts.note: U is the film-certificate abbreviation for universal
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A family member owns a complete collection of books.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's sister is a family member, so she counts as a relative.

clue.text: Article on farm animal biting motorists, silky beast

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another sits above it, so first

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: biting means the animal's jaws close round the other piece, which goes inside

parts.note: a goat is a farm animal
the RAC, the Royal Automobile Club, is a British motorists' organisation

explanation.surface: A farm animal attacks drivers, contrasted with a soft-coated creature.
explanation.definitionFit: This long-haired breed of feline has a notably soft, silky coat.

clue.text: Call made at the table — T-bone or fillet perhaps?

definitions.meaning: in bridge, a bid meaning the hand will be played without a trump suit
these are steak cuts that are not the rump cut, read as no T-bone being rump

explanation.surface: An order placed at a dinner table: a T-bone or fillet steak, maybe.
explanation.walkthrough: The table seems a dining table, but it is the bridge table; the second reading is 'not rump', describing steaks cut elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridge bid declaring play with no trump suit is a call made at the card table.

clue.text: Card one's not taken seriously

definitions.meaning: a playing card, the wild one in the pack
a person treated as a figure of fun, a clown

explanation.surface: A playing card that nobody treats seriously.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both the wild card in a pack and a person regarded as a buffoon.

clue.text: Jumper over the moon?

parts.note: a jumper is a jersey, and in the nursery rhyme 'Hey Diddle Diddle' the cow jumped over the moon

explanation.surface: A sweater that is delighted, 'over the moon' meaning thrilled.
explanation.definitionFit: This dairy breed from the Channel Island combines a word for sweater with the rhyme's leaping animal.

clue.text: Piece on Sixties youth that's taken over country

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: the king is a chess piece

indicators.note: taken over, in a down clue, says the word is flipped, read from bottom to top

parts.note: a mod was a member of a 1960s British youth subculture of scooters and sharp suits

explanation.surface: An article about 1960s youth who seized control of a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm ruled by a monarch is a nation or state.

clue.text: Glider daughter's dispatched deviating around star!

indicators.note: deviating around says the remaining letters wander off into a new order
the daughter has been sent away, so her letter is removed from the word

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A glider whose pilot's daughter was sent off veers around a star.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing D from GLIDER leaves GLIER, which 'deviating around' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a bright blue supergiant in the constellation Orion.

clue.text: Few like this going to Maine

parts.note: so means in this way, like this
ME is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Maine

explanation.surface: A handful of people heading off to Maine in this fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words indicate a small, unspecified number of things.

clue.text: Loafer that's not suitable for express train?

definitions.meaning: a slow railway carriage would not belong on a fast service

explanation.surface: A casual shoe that is wrong for a fast train journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A dawdler or idler is called this, and literally it is a sluggish railway carriage.

clue.text: Relative of 1 Down finally stumped

definitions.meaning: another breed of domestic feline, kin to the silky one
this breed from the Isle of Man is tailless, its end cut short

explanation.surface: A family member at last left baffled.
explanation.definitionFit: This tailless feline breed from the Isle of Man is a cousin of the long-haired breed.

clue.text: Gardening trough designed for catchment area

indicators.note: designed suggests the letters have been laid out to a new plan, rearranged

explanation.surface: A garden trough built to collect rainwater.
explanation.definitionFit: Hydrology uses this term for land from which rainwater drains into a reservoir or river.

clue.text: Problem having no opening to make money

indicators.note: the first letter, the opening, of the word for problem is removed

parts.note: trouble is a problem

explanation.surface: A difficulty about raising cash with no way in.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the currency of Russia, so a unit of money.

clue.text: Choice food's fragility

definitions.meaning: a dainty or rare item to eat; the 's stands for 'is' linking the two senses
delicateness, the quality of being easily broken

explanation.surface: The fragility of fine cuisine.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a rare treat to eat and fineness or frailty.

clue.text: Aspic ordered with pepper

indicators.note: ordered says the letters are put into a different sequence

parts.note: cum is Latin for with, as in 'kitchen-cum-dining room'

explanation.surface: Someone orders aspic jelly served with pepper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' looks like a restaurant request, but it rearranges ASPIC into CAPSI.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the botanical name for sweet and chilli peppers.

clue.text: Country fruit, dried before half-term

indicators.note: before puts the fruit ahead of the next piece

parts.note: a sultana is a dried grape

indicators.note: half takes the first two of the four letters of the word

explanation.surface: Rural produce dried out ahead of the school's mid-term break.
explanation.definitionFit: A state ruled by a sultan, such as Oman, is a nation.

clue.text: Put in order, buy, eat — lovely!

indicators.note: putting letters in order means rearranging them

explanation.surface: A shopping list: tidy up, buy, eat, wonderful!
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of delight at something splendid, as in 'You little beauty!'

clue.text: Damage a route for escape

parts.note: to break is to damage
a way is a route

explanation.surface: Wrecking a road to make a getaway.
explanation.definitionFit: A breaking free from captivity or a group is an escape.

clue.text: You strayed badly in the recent past

parts.note: ye is an old form of you

indicators.note: badly says the letters are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: You went astray in a bad way not long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'You' must be YE: anagramming all of 'You strayed' gives the wrong letters. 'badly' rearranges STRAYED into STERDAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adverb it means on the day before today, or lately.

clue.text: Not allowed to consume fat

indicators.note: the clue words swallow the answer, which lies inside them across the word break

explanation.surface: Someone is forbidden to eat fatty food.
explanation.definitionFit: This is hard animal fat used for candles and soap.

clue.text: Get a hundred to join singers on the radio

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: on the radio means the word is heard rather than seen

parts.note: a choir is a group of singers

explanation.surface: Recruit a hundred people to join singers on a broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: To obtain or come to possess something is to get it.

clue.text: Calls back for the second time?

definitions.text: Calls back for the second time?

parts.words: Calls back for the second time?
parts.note: an echo is a sound called back; doing it again adds the prefix meaning again

explanation.surface: Someone returns a call a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To resound once more is literally to call back again.

clue.text: Expecting to start late exercising power

indicators.note: the word arrives late for its start, so its first letter is missing

parts.note: expecting means expecting a baby

explanation.surface: A mother-to-be expects to begin her maternity leave later.
explanation.definitionFit: This adjective describes a reigning monarch, one wielding sovereign authority.

clue.text: Played ace OK, nibbling at biscuit

indicators.note: nibbling means the jumbled letters have the next word in their mouth, inside them
played suggests the letters are moved around like cards in play

explanation.surface: A card player plays an ace and snacks on a cracker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Played' turns ACE OK into OCAKE; 'nibbling' puts AT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat Scottish oatmeal cracker is a kind of savoury biscuit.

clue.text: It's for those who need fresh air in the main

definitions.text: It's for those who need fresh air in the main

parts.words: It's for those who need fresh air in the main
parts.note: 'in the main' seems to mean mostly, but the main is the sea, where divers need breathing apparatus

explanation.surface: Something meant chiefly for people who want to get outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Underwater divers carry this breathing apparatus for a supply of air below the sea.

clue.text: Partly harmful, certainly that's sore

indicators.note: Partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something is to some extent damaging, definitely painful.
explanation.definitionFit: An open lesion on skin or a membrane is a painful spot.

clue.text: Boiler found in the kitchen

parts.note: a 'boiler' suggests central heating, but here it is the appliance that boils water for tea

explanation.surface: A central-heating boiler installed in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: This household appliance heats water to boiling, typically on a kitchen worktop.

clue.text: One gets rich as if by magic

definitions.text: One gets rich as if by magic

parts.words: One gets rich as if by magic
parts.note: a sorcerer seems implied, but it is a person with a genius for making money

explanation.surface: Someone who becomes wealthy through sorcery.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone brilliant with money seems to conjure wealth like a magician.

clue.text: Give way, top tennis player said

indicators.note: said tells us the word is heard, not written as it is spelt

parts.note: a seed is a top-ranked player in a tennis tournament draw

explanation.surface: A leading tennis player concedes in a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To yield or surrender, especially territory or a point, is to give way.

clue.text: Irritable, having no spirit with Raymond around

indicators.note: around says the name sits on either side of the other piece

parts.note: Ray is the short form of the name Raymond
TT, teetotal, describes someone who drinks no alcohol, no spirits

explanation.surface: A man called Raymond is cross because there is no drink left.
explanation.definitionFit: This is informal British slang for bad-tempered or easily annoyed.

clue.text: Kind of light, to a great extent

definitions.meaning: a ... light is a coloured flare fired from a pistol as a signal

explanation.surface: A sort of lamp that is bright in large measure.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a signal flare invented by Edward Very and is also an intensifying adverb.
